**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Give a clear and short description of the problem. For example: I cannot do X because [...]

**Describe the solution you want**
Give a clear and short description of what you want to happen.

**Describe the alternatives you considered**
Give a clear and short description of any other solutions or features you considered.

**SDK parity**
The Blaaiz SDKs for Java, Node.js, Laravel/PHP, and Python expose the same API surface. Tell us
if another SDK already has this feature, and give the method name.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
